rubric_items.reason: All 13 known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-13) are traced by at least one story. The intent has no assumed REQs.
Each story has one outcome: the count, the exclusions, independence from the period selector, the linked list, the unchanged dashboard and no personal data.

S-3 AC1 now catches a tile that filters by period. The boundaries at now, local date vs UTC date and the limit of 10 are covered. S-5 never changes the period for the other tiles, so a leaked period exception would pass.

Each value comes from the intent or is worked out correctly: UTC+05:30 for Asia/Kolkata, 00:30 local = 19:00 UTC the day before, Last 7 days = 12-18 Nov, Last 30 days starts 20 Oct, and the limit of 10.
Clear and uses the same terms throughout. The body now matches the front matter. S-4 AC2 does not state now, which its A3 case depends on.

findings.text: S-5 AC1/AC2 check the other tiles without choosing a period. If REQ-7's exception leaked into the other period-based tiles (they stop following the selector), Today alone would not show it.

cites.quote: every other tile shows the same count as before this change
A run of whole hospital-local days ending today: Today, Last 7 days or Last 30 days.

findings.suggested_fix: Add an S-5 AC that switches from Today to Last 7 days and checks that each other period tile's count changes exactly as it did before this change.

findings.text: S-4 AC2 does not state now. A3 at 00:30 local on 18 November only counts if now is after it, so the Given is not fully pinned down. S-4 AC1 states now as 10:00.

cites.quote: Given Scheduled A3 started at 00:30 local on 18 November (19:00 UTC on 17 November)

findings.suggested_fix: Start S-4 AC2 with 'Given now is 10:00 local on 18 November'.
